body.x: (Picture description: MobiFren GBH-S700)“CES 2016”, the world’s largest IT consumer Technology exhibition, was held for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.Again this year, outstanding domestic small and medium-sized companies caught foreign buyers’ eyes. Among those companies, GT Telecom really stood out.The company specializes in Bluetooth devices, and last year, it showcased outstanding performance in the Bluetooth audio equipment field.In 2015, the company was running on all cylinders, continuously launching new products for its premium Bluetooth headset MobiFren series.In particular, the company is receiving much attention for its radio and a vibration function for games of the neckband-type MobiFren “GBH-S700”. The “GBH-S500 (Neckmaster)” has entered European markets, including France.Furthermore, the company has continued to launch its product series, including the cable-type headset “GBH-S840”, which is very popular these days. The others are the company’s first headphone-type headset “GBH-S910”, and “GBH-S3000”, Bluetooth earphones for first-time users.In addition, the launch of “Project 870” -- the first and top premium model in the Bluetooth audio equipment market -- is just around the corner.GT Telecom CEO Heo Ju-won, who participated in this CES 2016, said: “Our participation last year was to show the MobiFren series’ high-quality audio and technology. This year, we were able to showcase more varied lineups of the MobiFren series. We promoted them as attractive products, going far beyond simple audio equipment with high-quality sound.”At this CES, the company had many meetings about product inquiries and technology sharing with diverse buyers from the U.S. and Europe.→ Go to 'CES 2016' news page
